title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 2,301–2,350 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

examples.en: Schools now offer dedicated workshops to support student mental health.
examples.zh: 學校現在開設了專屬工作坊以全力支持學生的心理健康。

examples.en: Work-life balance plays a vital role in sustaining long-term mental health.
examples.zh: 工作與生活間的平衡對於維持長期的身心健康扮演著關鍵角色。

examples.en: Open discussions help break the stigma surrounding mental health issues.
examples.zh: 公開坦誠的討論有助於破除社會對心理精神健康議題的刻板偏見。

examples.en: Professional psychological counseling provides a safe space to share feelings.
examples.zh: 專業心理諮商能提供一個安心安全的空間傾訴內心感受。

examples.en: The university career center offers free resume counseling for graduating seniors.
examples.zh: 大學就業輔導中心為應屆畢業生提供免費的履歷健檢諮商輔導。

examples.en: Marriage counseling helped the couple resolve deep-seated communication barriers.
examples.zh: 婚姻諮商協助這對夫妻化解了根深蒂固的溝通障礙。

words.definition: 心理治療師；臨床治療師

examples.en: Talking with a licensed therapist helped him manage severe work anxiety.
examples.zh: 與領有合格執照的治療師晤談幫助他克服了嚴重的職場焦慮。

examples.en: The speech therapist taught the young child how to pronounce difficult consonants correctly.
examples.zh: 語言治療師悉心教導年幼孩子如何正確發出困難的子音音節。

examples.en: Her physical therapist recommended gentle stretching exercises for her sore shoulder.
examples.zh: 她的物理治療師建議做些溫和的拉筋伸展運動以舒緩肩膀痠痛。

examples.en: Clinical psychologists conduct tests to assess cognitive development.
examples.zh: 臨床心理師透過各項心理測驗來評估個案的認知發展狀況。

examples.en: Educational psychologists study how classroom environments influence student motivation.
examples.zh: 教育心理學家深入探討教室學習環境如何影響學生的學習動機。

examples.en: The forensic psychologist testified about the defendant's mental state in court.
examples.zh: 司法心理學家出庭就被告當時的精神心智狀態作證說明。

examples.en: Regular outdoor exercise and professional therapy help relieve depression.
examples.zh: 定期戶外運動搭配專業治療有助於有效緩解憂鬱症狀。

examples.en: Major depression is a medical condition that requires compassionate medical care.
examples.zh: 重度憂鬱症是一種正經的醫學疾患，需要給予充滿同理心的醫療照護。

examples.en: Many small businesses struggled to survive during the severe economic depression.
examples.zh: 在那場嚴重的經濟大蕭條期間，許多小型中小企業舉步維艱難以存活。

examples.en: Deep breathing techniques can calm down sudden exam anxiety.
examples.zh: 深呼吸放鬆技巧能平復考試前突如其來的焦慮不安。

examples.en: Waiting for medical biopsy results caused days of intense anxiety for the family.
examples.zh: 等待醫學切片檢查報告出爐的日子，讓全家上下度過了數日極度焦慮煎熬。

examples.en: Social anxiety makes public speaking nerve-wracking for introverted people.
examples.zh: 社交焦慮往往會讓生性內向的人在公開演講發言時感到無比緊張。

examples.en: Focus on slow breathing if you experience symptoms of a panic attack.
examples.zh: 若察覺出現恐慌發作的生理徵兆，請先專注於緩慢吐氣吸氣。

examples.en: During a sudden panic attack, her heart raced and she felt dizzy.
examples.zh: 在突發的恐慌發作過程中，她心跳劇烈加速並且感到一陣暈眩。

examples.en: Learning grounding grounding techniques can help manage the onset of a panic attack.
examples.zh: 學習著陸定心技巧有助於妥善應對恐慌發作初期的不適反應。

examples.en: Avoiding screen time before bedtime helps treat chronic insomnia.
examples.zh: 睡前避免滑手機使用 3C 螢幕有助於改善長期慢性失眠。

examples.en: High work stress and excessive caffeine intake often lead to frustrating insomnia.
examples.zh: 沉重的工作壓力與攝取過量咖啡因常會引發令人煩悶的失眠困擾。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed mild herbal teas to relieve her temporary insomnia.
examples.zh: 醫師建議飲用溫和的草本花草茶，以緩解她短暫的失眠困擾。

examples.en: Practicing morning mindfulness meditation clears mental clutter.
examples.zh: 早晨練習正念冥想靜心能掃除大腦思緒中的雜念煩憂。

examples.en: Guided meditation apps help beginners master breathing rhythms effortlessly.
examples.zh: 引導式冥想 App 能幫助冥想新手輕鬆掌握平穩的呼吸節奏。

examples.en: Ten minutes of silent meditation before sleep promotes deeper rest.
examples.zh: 睡前進行十分鐘的安靜冥想能帶來更深沉甜美的優質睡眠。

words.definition: 身心健康；全人健康福祉

examples.en: Modern fitness clubs emphasize holistic wellness, combining yoga and nutrition.
examples.zh: 現代健身中心強調結合瑜珈與營養的全人身心健康理念。

examples.en: Corporate wellness programs offer gym subsidies and ergonomic desk setups.
examples.zh: 企業員工健康福祉專案提供健身房補助與人體工學升降辦公桌椅配備。

examples.en: Taking a weekend retreat in nature can restore your emotional wellness.
examples.zh: 到大自然中度過一趟週末靜修之旅，能有效重啟並修復你的情緒健康。

examples.en: Proper nutrition during childhood fuels healthy bone and brain development.
examples.zh: 童年時期均衡充足的營養攝取是骨骼與大腦健全發育的基石。

examples.en: The certified dietitian gave an informative lecture on sports nutrition.
examples.zh: 具備國家執照的營養師就運動營養學進行了內容豐富精闢的專題演講。

examples.en: Malnutrition remains a serious challenge in impoverished rural regions.
examples.zh: 營養不良在貧困落後的偏遠鄉村地區依舊是一項嚴峻的民生挑戰。

examples.en: Dark green leafy vegetables are packed with essential vitamins and nutrients.
examples.zh: 深綠色葉菜類蔬菜富含人體不可或缺的多種維生素與必需營養素。

examples.en: Fertile soil delivers vital nutrients to crops through organic composting.
examples.zh: 肥沃的土壤透過有機堆肥為農作物輸送源源不絕的關鍵營養成分。

examples.en: Overcooking vegetables can destroy delicate heat-sensitive nutrients like vitamin C.
examples.zh: 過度高溫久煮蔬菜容易破壞維生素 C 等不耐熱的嬌貴營養素。

examples.en: Eating a balanced diet with whole grains and vegetables prevents lifestyle diseases.
examples.zh: 攝取包含全穀雜糧與充足蔬菜的均衡飲食能預防各類文明病。

examples.en: A balanced diet should include adequate proteins, healthy fats, and fiber.
examples.zh: 均衡健康的飲食應涵蓋足量的優質蛋白質、好油脂肪與膳食纖維。

examples.en: School lunch programs must adhere strictly to balanced diet nutritional guidelines.
examples.zh: 各級學校的營養午餐菜單設計必須嚴格遵守均衡飲食的營養指引標準。

examples.en: Check food packaging labels to track your daily calorie intake.
examples.zh: 仔細查閱食品外包裝標示以掌握每日常見的卡路里熱量攝取。

examples.en: Swimming laps burns more calories per hour than casual walking.
examples.zh: 游泳繞圈每小時所消耗燃燒的熱量卡路里遠高於一般的散步漫步。

examples.en: Highly processed sugary sodas contain empty calories with little nutritional value.
examples.zh: 高度加工的高糖汽水飲料只含有空洞熱量，幾乎毫無實質營養價值。

examples.en: Many people take vitamin C and fish oil dietary supplements daily.
examples.zh: 許多人每日習慣服用維生素 C 與深海魚油等膳食營養補充品。

examples.en: He works overtime on weekends to supplement his regular monthly salary.
examples.zh: 他利用週末休假日加班兼差，藉此補貼貼補每月的固定底薪收入。

examples.en: The Sunday newspaper included an educational magazine supplement.
examples.zh: 該份週日出刊的報紙額外隨報附贈了一本內容扎實的教育副刊雜誌。

examples.en: Adequate sleep and regular exercise strengthen your body's immune system.
examples.zh: 充足優質的睡眠與規律運動能增強人體自身的免疫系統防護力。

examples.en: A weakened immune system makes individuals more vulnerable to seasonal flu.
examples.zh: 虛弱低下的免疫系統會讓個體更容易遭受季節性流感病毒的感染。

examples.en: Chronic lack of rest takes a heavy toll on the human immune system.
examples.zh: 長期缺乏睡眠休養會對人體的免疫防護防線造成嚴重的慢性折損。

examples.en: Vaccinations help human bodies develop protective immunity against viruses.
examples.zh: 接種疫苗能幫助人體建立起對抗致命病毒的保護性免疫力。

examples.en: Diplomatic immunity protects accredited foreign envoys from local prosecution.
examples.zh: 外交豁免權保障了派駐當地的外國使節官員免受在地法律的刑事追訴。

examples.en: Natural immunity acquired after recovering from measles lasts a lifetime.
examples.zh: 罹患麻疹康復痊癒後所獲得的天然自體免疫力通常能終身維持。

examples.en: Flu vaccines are offered free of charge to elderly citizens every autumn.
examples.zh: 每年秋季政府都會為年長長者提供免費的流感疫苗接種服務。

examples.en: Medical researchers worked around the clock to develop a safe mRNA vaccine.
examples.zh: 醫學科研人員日以繼夜全力研發安全有效的新型 mRNA 疫苗。

examples.en: Store temperature-sensitive vaccines inside specialized ultra-cold medical freezers.
examples.zh: 請將溫控敏感的特定疫苗存放在專業的醫用超低溫冷凍冷藏箱中。

examples.en: Childhood vaccination programs protect the public from severe epidemics.
examples.zh: 幼童常規疫苗接種計畫保護廣大社會大眾免於嚴重傳染病威脅。

examples.en: High community vaccination rates create robust herd protection against disease.
examples.zh: 崇高的社區疫苗接種普及率能築起抵禦傳染病擴散的群體免疫防線。

examples.en: Bring your official yellow immunization card when attending vaccination clinics.
examples.zh: 前往衛生所或診所接種施打疫苗時，請隨身攜帶兒童健康手冊與黃卡。

examples.en: Mild fever and muscle soreness are common temporary vaccine side effects.
examples.zh: 輕微發燒與肌肉痠痛是常見且短暫的疫苗接種副作用。

examples.en: Drowsiness is a well-known side effect of certain antihistamine allergy medicines.
examples.zh: 嗜睡昏昏欲睡是某些抗組織胺抗過敏藥物常見且人所皆知的副作用。

examples.en: The economic stimulus package produced unintended inflationary side effects.
examples.zh: 該項大規模經濟振興方案意外引發了通貨膨脹攀升的連鎖負面副作用。

examples.en: Inform the restaurant waiter immediately if you are allergic to peanuts.
examples.zh: 若您對花生等堅果過敏，請務必在點餐時第一時間告知服務生。

examples.en: My younger brother is severely allergic to cat dander and bee stings.
examples.zh: 我弟弟對貓咪皮屑毛髮與蜜蜂叮咬有著極度劇烈的嚴重過敏體質。

examples.en: Many people develop allergic skin rashes after touching poison ivy.
examples.zh: 許多人在皮膚不慎接觸到毒藤蔓後，會長出奇癢難耐的過敏性紅疹。

examples.en: Dust mites and animal fur can trigger seasonal nasal allergies.
examples.zh: 塵蟎與動物毛屑容易誘發季節性過敏性鼻炎。

examples.en: She underwent skin prick testing to pinpoint the exact source of her food allergy.
examples.zh: 她接受了皮膚針刺過敏原測試，以精準找出誘發食物過敏的真正源頭。

examples.en: Severe peanut allergies can lead to life-threatening anaphylactic reactions.
examples.zh: 嚴重的花生堅果過敏症狀可能會迅速惡化為危及生命的過敏性休克。

words.definition: 慢性的；長期的；積習難改的

examples.en: Regular health checkups help detect chronic conditions like high cholesterol early.
examples.zh: 定期健康檢查有助於及早發現高膽固醇等慢性健康問題。

examples.en: He struggled with chronic insomnia caused by prolonged career stress.
examples.zh: 長期沈重的工作職業壓力讓他常年深受慢性失眠之苦。

examples.en: Managing chronic back pain often requires a combination of therapy and exercise.
examples.zh: 妥善控制慢性的下背痛問題通常需要搭配物理治療與核心肌力鍛鍊。

examples.en: The patient was rushed to the ER suffering from acute appendicitis.
examples.zh: 該名病患因急性闌尾盲腸炎發作被火速送往急診室救治。

examples.en: Dogs possess an exceptionally acute sense of smell and hearing.
examples.zh: 狗狗擁有極其敏銳發達的嗅覺靈敏度與聽覺感知能力。

examples.en: The city faced an acute shortage of potable drinking water during the summer drought.
examples.zh: 在那場罕見的盛夏乾旱期間，這座城市面臨了極度嚴峻的飲用水短缺危機。

examples.en: Reducing salt and fried food intake helps manage high blood pressure (hypertension).
examples.zh: 減少鹽分與油炸重鹹食物攝取有助於控制高血壓（hypertension）。

examples.en: If left untreated, severe hypertension increases the risk of stroke and heart disease.
examples.zh: 若任其發展不加妥善治療，長期嚴重高血壓會大幅增加中風與心臟病風險。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed a low-dose medication to stabilize his hypertension.
examples.zh: 醫師開立了溫和低劑量的降血壓藥物，以協助穩定他的高血壓病情。

examples.en: Patients with diabetes monitor their daily blood sugar levels diligently.
examples.zh: 糖尿病病友每日均認真嚴格監控自己的血糖數值。

examples.en: A diet low in refined carbohydrates helps prevent type 2 diabetes.
examples.zh: 採取低精緻澱粉碳水化合物的健康飲食型態，有助於預防第二型糖尿病。

examples.en: Daily insulin injections allow people with diabetes to lead active lives.
examples.zh: 每日按時注射胰島素能讓廣大糖尿病患者維持活力充沛的正常生活。

examples.en: Childhood obesity has become a major public health concern globally.
examples.zh: 兒童肥胖症已演變成全球公共衛生領域的一大關注焦點。

examples.en: Replacing sugary soft drinks with plain water is a simple step to fight obesity.
examples.zh: 用純淨白開水全面取代含糖汽水飲料，是有效對抗肥胖的關鍵第一步。

examples.en: Regular aerobic exercise combined with portion control reduces the risk of obesity.
examples.zh: 規律的有氧體能鍛鍊搭配每餐份量控制，能顯著降低過度肥胖的風險。

examples.en: The doctor ordered a routine blood test to check liver and kidney function.
examples.zh: 醫師安排了例行常規抽血檢驗以評估肝腎各項功能指數。

examples.en: You must fast for eight hours before taking an accurate fasting blood test.
examples.zh: 為了確保空腹抽血檢驗的精準度，受檢前必須先嚴格禁食八小時。

examples.en: The lab completed the urgent blood test within two hours.
examples.zh: 檢驗醫學實驗室在短短兩小時內便火速完成了這項緊急抽血檢驗報告。

examples.en: The orthopedic surgeon took an X-ray to check for hairline wrist fractures.
examples.zh: 骨科醫師安排照了 X 光片以檢查手腕是否有隱匿性微細骨折。

examples.en: Dental clinics take panoramic X-rays to assess wisdom tooth growth.
examples.zh: 牙醫診所拍攝全口環景 X 光片以評估智齒的生長與埋伏生長走向。

examples.en: Airport security uses X-ray scanners to inspect all carry-on baggage.
examples.zh: 機場安檢處運用先進的 X 光行李掃描儀全面透視檢查所有隨身登機行李。

examples.en: Expectant mothers look at clear fetal ultrasound scans with pure joy.
examples.zh: 準媽媽們滿懷無比喜悅看著清晰的胎兒產檢超音波影像。

examples.en: The physician ordered an abdominal ultrasound to examine the gallbladder.
examples.zh: 內科醫師安排了腹部超音波檢查以詳細檢視膽囊內部是否有結石病變。

examples.en: Bats navigate and hunt insects in total darkness using high-frequency ultrasound.
examples.zh: 蝙蝠在漆黑無光的深夜中，巧妙利用自身發射的高頻超音波定位飛行並捕獵昆蟲。

examples.en: The specialist diagnosed the rare skin rash after conducting lab tests.
examples.zh: 專科醫師在完成各項實驗室檢驗後，確診了該罕見皮膚紅疹。

examples.en: Doctors diagnosed her with mild pneumonia and prescribed antibiotic treatment.
examples.zh: 醫師診斷她罹患了輕微肺炎，並立即為她開立了對症的抗生素療程。

examples.en: Automotive technicians used computer software to diagnose the vehicle engine fault.
examples.zh: 汽車維修技師運用專業電腦診斷軟體，迅速查明了車輛引擎故障代碼原因。

words.definition: 診斷；診斷結果（複數 diagnoses）

examples.en: An early medical diagnosis significantly improves patient recovery rates.
examples.zh: 及早獲得明確的醫學診斷能顯著大幅提升病患的康復痊癒率。

examples.en: The family sought a second opinion after receiving a serious cancer diagnosis.
examples.zh: 在獲知罹患重大癌症的震驚診斷後，家屬決定尋求第二位專科權威醫師的複診意見。

examples.en: The technician explained his accurate diagnosis of the broken refrigerator compressor.
examples.zh: 維修技術人員向屋主條理分明地說明了他對冰箱壓縮機損壞原因的精確診斷。

examples.en: Skilled cardiac surgeons performed a successful heart bypass operation.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的心臟外科執刀醫師成功完成了心臟血管繞道手術。

examples.en: The orthopedic surgeon reattached the severed tendon with great precision.
examples.zh: 骨科執刀醫師以極為精準的手術技術將斷裂的肌腱重新吻合接合。

examples.en: Becoming a certified neurosurgeon requires over a decade of rigorous training.
examples.zh: 要想成為一名合格的神經外科主任醫師，需要歷經十餘年極其嚴苛的專業訓練。

examples.en: Minimally invasive surgery results in smaller wounds and faster healing.
examples.zh: 微創外科手術傷口極小且能讓術後復原時間大幅縮短。

examples.en: The athlete underwent knee ligament surgery and will miss the remainder of the season.
examples.zh: 這位體育選手接受了膝蓋韌帶重建手術，確定將缺席本賽季後續所有賽事。

examples.en: Advances in robotic surgery allow operations to be completed with millimeter precision.
examples.zh: 達文西機器人手臂手術的突破進步使手術操作精度能達到毫米級的細膩水準。

examples.en: The anesthesiologist administered general anesthesia before the procedure began.
examples.zh: 麻醉專科醫師在手術開始前為病患施作了全身麻醉。

examples.en: Dental patients often receive local anesthesia before cavity fillings or extractions.
examples.zh: 牙科病人在接受蛀牙補牙或拔牙療程前，通常會先施打局部麻醉針。

examples.en: She felt groggy and thirsty as the effects of the anesthesia wore off.
examples.zh: 當麻醉藥劑的藥效逐漸退去時，她感覺頭昏腦脹且喉嚨異常口渴。

examples.en: Critical patients receive 24-hour constant monitoring in the intensive care unit.
examples.zh: 重症病患在加護病房內接受二十四小時全天候精密監護照護。

examples.en: Relatives waited anxiously outside the doors of the intensive care unit.
examples.zh: 家屬們心急如焚地在加護病房緊閉的大門外焦急守候。

examples.en: The patient made steady progress and was moved from the intensive care unit to a regular ward.
examples.zh: 病患各項生命體徵穩步好轉，順利從加護病房轉至一般普通病房繼續休養。

examples.en: Ambulances rushed injured car crash victims directly to the hospital emergency room.
examples.zh: 救護車將車禍受傷傷患第一時間火速載送至醫院急診室救治。

examples.en: Triage nurses assess patient urgency upon arrival at the busy emergency room.
examples.zh: 檢傷分類護理師在病患送達人滿為患的急診室時，立即進行傷病嚴重度分級。

examples.en: The emergency room was packed on New Year's Eve with holiday emergencies.
examples.zh: 跨年夜當晚的醫院急診室擠滿了各式各樣突發急症的就診人潮。

examples.en: Learning basic first aid techniques enables you to save lives in crises.
examples.zh: 學習基礎急救技巧能讓你在危急意外關頭挽救寶貴生命。

examples.en: The scout leader administered first aid to the hiker who scraped his elbow.
examples.zh: 童軍團長為登山途中不慎擦傷手肘的登山同伴進行了初步急救敷裹。

examples.en: All lifeguards must hold valid certifications in cardiopulmonary first aid.
examples.zh: 所有合格救生員均必須持有仍在有效效期內的急救心肺復甦合格證照。

examples.en: Every household and classroom should have an easily accessible first aid kit.
examples.zh: 每個家庭與學校教室內都應配備放置於顯眼易取處的急救箱。

examples.en: We packed bandages, antiseptic wipes, and tweezers into our hiking first aid kit.
examples.zh: 我們在登山急救包裡備齊了彈性繃帶、無菌消毒棉片以及專用小鑷子。

examples.en: Inspect your car first aid kit annually to replace any expired medication.
examples.zh: 每年定期開箱檢視車用急救箱，以即時淘汰並更換任何過期常備藥品。

examples.en: Performing continuous chest compressions (CPR) keeps blood flowing to the brain.
examples.zh: 持續施行胸外按壓心肺復甦術（CPR）能維持大腦血液供氧。

examples.en: Bystanders acted heroically by performing CPR until paramedics arrived on the scene.
examples.zh: 熱心目擊民眾見義勇為，在救護人員趕抵現場前接力持續施行 CPR。

examples.en: The community center hosts free CPR and AED practical training sessions.
examples.zh: 社區活動中心定期舉辦免費的心肺復甦術（CPR）與 AED 實作訓練課程。

words.definition: 自動體外心臟電擊去顫器 (AED)

examples.en: Public metro stations in Taiwan are all equipped with automated external defibrillators (AEDs).
examples.zh: 台灣各大捷運車站均全面普及設置了 AED 自動體外心臟電擊器。

examples.en: The automated defibrillator delivers a guided electric shock to restore regular heart rhythm.
examples.zh: 自動電擊去顫器能釋放精準語音引導的電擊，協助心臟恢復正常跳動心律。

examples.en: Clear voice instructions guide lay rescuers on how to use the portable defibrillator.
examples.zh: 設備內建極其清晰明瞭的真人語音指示，引導非專業施救者正確操作攜帶型電擊器。

examples.en: The school nurse applied a sterile gauze bandage to the bleeding knee.
examples.zh: 校護阿姨用無菌紗布與彈性繃帶為擦傷流血的膝蓋進行包紮。

examples.en: He carefully wrapped an elastic compression bandage around his strained wrist.
examples.zh: 他小心翼翼地用彈性加壓繃帶將拉傷發炎的手腕緊緊包覆固定好。

examples.en: Change the wound bandage daily to keep the affected skin clean and dry.
examples.zh: 傷口上的包紮敷料繃帶應每日定時更換，以確保患部皮膚乾淨透氣乾爽。

examples.en: Press a sterile gauze pad firmly onto the cut to stop bleeding.
examples.zh: 將無菌紗布塊緊緊按壓在傷口上方以迅速達到止血效果。

examples.en: Medical-grade cotton gauze absorbs fluids without sticking to healing skin.
examples.zh: 醫療級無菌棉紗布能充分吸附組織液，且不會沾黏撕裂癒合中的脆弱傷口。

examples.en: She applied antibiotic ointment directly onto the sterile gauze before dressing the burn.
examples.zh: 在包紮燙傷傷口前，她先將抗生素消炎藥膏直接擠在無菌紗布墊上。

examples.en: Spray medical alcohol disinfectant to sanitize high-touch doorknobs.
examples.zh: 噴灑醫用酒精消毒液對經常觸摸的門把進行環境清消。

examples.en: Hospitals use hospital-grade chemical disinfectants to clean surgical suites.
examples.zh: 醫院內部採用高規格醫療級化學消毒劑對外科手術室進行徹底清消。

examples.en: Wash the minor scrape with mild disinfectant before applying an adhesive bandage.
examples.zh: 在貼上透氣防水 OK 繃前，先用溫和不刺激的消毒藥水清洗輕微擦傷處。

examples.en: Wearing ill-fitting hiking boots caused painful blisters on my heels.
examples.zh: 穿著不合腳的登山靴導致我的腳後跟磨出了疼痛的水泡。

examples.en: Do not pop water blisters with needles, as intact skin protects against infection.
examples.zh: 切勿自行拿縫衣針刺破水泡，完整無損的表皮是防止細菌感染的最佳天然防線。

examples.en: Rowers often develop thick calluses over time after dealing with hand blisters.
examples.zh: 划船隊選手在長期經歷雙手摩擦起水泡後，手掌上漸漸磨出了厚實的硬繭。

examples.en: Apply ice packs and elevate your leg if you sprain your ankle playing basketball.
examples.zh: 打籃球不慎扭傷腳踝時，請立即冰敷並將患肢適度抬高。

examples.en: It took three full weeks of rest for his severe ankle sprain to heal.
examples.zh: 他嚴重的腳踝關節扭傷足足休養了整整三個星期才徹底痊癒。

examples.en: Wearing supportive high-top athletic shoes can reduce the risk of a sprain.
examples.zh: 穿著具備良好支撐防護的高筒專業運動鞋能大幅降低運動扭傷的機率。

examples.en: The skier suffered a minor leg bone fracture after slipping on ice.
examples.zh: 滑雪選手在冰面上滑倒後導致腿部輕微骨折。

examples.en: A protective fiberglass cast was applied to immobilize the arm fracture.
examples.zh: 醫師為他打上了堅固輕盈的玻璃纖維石膏夾板，以固定手部骨折患處。

examples.en: Disagreements over zoning laws caused an internal fracture within the municipal committee.
examples.zh: 土地分區管制法規上的重大分歧導致該市政審議委員會內部出現了深層分裂裂痕。

examples.en: Physical rehabilitation helps stroke patients regain limb mobility gradually.
examples.zh: 物理復健能幫助中風病患逐步重新恢復肢體靈活活動能力。

examples.en: The injured pitcher spent six grueling months in physical rehabilitation before throwing again.
examples.zh: 這位手肘受傷的王牌投手在復健中心歷經了整整六個月的艱辛復健訓練才重返投手丘。

examples.en: The community shelter runs addiction rehabilitation programs to support homeless individuals.
examples.zh: 社區庇護所積極開辦成癮戒斷復健輔導課程，協助無家可歸者重返社會生活。

examples.en: He attends physical therapy sessions twice a week for lower back pain.
examples.zh: 他每週前往診所進行兩次物理治療以改善長年的下背痛問題。

examples.en: Gentle stretching guided by a physical therapy professional relieves muscular tension.
examples.zh: 在專業物理治療師的親自引導下進行溫和拉筋，能舒緩長期緊繃的深層肌肉。

examples.en: After joint surgery, completing your assigned physical therapy exercises is essential for recovery.
examples.zh: 關節置換手術後，按部就班切實完成規定的物理治療復健運動對術後康復至關重要。

examples.en: Drink warm water, rest well, and you will recover from the cold soon.
examples.zh: 多喝溫開水、好好充分休息，你的感冒很快就會康復痊癒了。

examples.en: Police managed to recover stolen valuable jewelry and return it to the owner.
examples.zh: 警方抽絲剝繭迅速破案，成功找回追回了遭竊取的貴重珠寶並原物歸還失主。

examples.en: The tourism sector began to recover rapidly once international flight borders reopened.
examples.zh: 國際航班邊境大門重新敞開後，各地觀光旅遊業景氣便開始強勁復甦反彈。
